title: EPI-ROB: browser-based risk-of-bias assessment (RoB 2, ROBINS-I, QUADAS-2, PROBAST, AMSTAR 2)
description: Browser tool for risk-of-bias and critical appraisal in systematic reviews: signalling questions with the official RoB 2, QUADAS-2, PROBAST and AMSTAR 2 algorithms (RoB 2 verified against all answer combinations), ROBINS-I, two-reviewer agreement (Cohen's kappa) and consensus, traffic-light and summary figures for journals, robvis-compatible import/export and methods text. All data stay in the browser.
